test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The respondents were very agile and ______ in subduing the situation.
solution: The correct answer is **"quick."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Agile"** means quick and nimble. • So the most appropriate option to fill in the blank is **"quick."** • **"Quick"** means done with speed; taking or lasting a short time. (फुरती से किया गया; थोड़ा समय लेने या रहने वाला) • **Example:** *May I make a **quick**__ telephone call?* • So, the correct answer is **Option 2**. **Correct sentence:** *The respondents were very agile and __**quick**__ in subduing the situation.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • The word **"hassled"** means stressed or overwhelmed, which does not fit the context of the sentence. (किसी को झुंझला देना (विशेषतः कोई काम अनेक बार करने के लिए कहकर)) • The word** "tedious"** means boring or tiresome, which also does not fit the context of the sentence. (उबाऊ और (समय की दृष्टि से) लंबा) • The word **"tasty" **means delicious, which has no relevance to the situation being described. (स्‍वादिष्‍ट, ज़ायके़दार) 1c2:T4e7,The correct answer is **"Find exactly the right answer."**
